morphology.pattern_note: 名词前缀 peN- 在 /l/ 前呈 pe- 形式，词根 lali 的 /l/ 保留；表示使人进入 lali 状态的物质。

word_family.gloss: 使失去感觉的过程；另可指免疫接种

senses.zh_definition: 使感觉减弱、消失或使意识降低的药物等物质；麻醉剂或镇静剂，具体所指取决于语境。
senses.en_definition: A drug or other substance that reduces or abolishes sensation or awareness; an anaesthetic or sedative, depending on context.
senses.ms_definition: Ubat atau bahan lain yang boleh melalikan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 ubat pelali。它是较宽泛的名称，不能单凭该词判断是局部麻醉、全身麻醉还是镇静，也不等同于所有止痛药。不要把 pelali 与 pelalian 的“免疫接种”义混为一谈。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pelali)。

collocations.zh: 麻醉药或镇静药的作用
collocations.en: the effects of an anaesthetic or sedative

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Doktor menerangkan tujuan pemberian ubat pelali kepada pesakit sebelum prosedur dimulakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 医生在操作开始前，向患者说明使用麻醉或镇静药物的目的。
dual_scenarios.en: Before the procedure began, the doctor explained to the patient why the anaesthetic or sedative would be administered.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Doktor dah terangkan pasal ubat pelali tu ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah doktor sudah menerangkan tentang ubat pelali itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 医生已经跟你解释那个麻醉药的事了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has the doctor explained the anaesthetic to you yet?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 构成口语疑问

messages.speaker: Amir (哥哥)
messages.ms_spoken: Doktor dah terangkan pasal ubat pelali tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah doktor sudah menerangkan tentang ubat pelali itu?
messages.zh: 医生已经跟你解释那个麻醉药的事了吗？
messages.en: Has the doctor explained the anaesthetic to you yet?

messages.speaker: Aina (妹妹)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, tapi aku nak tanya satu dua soalan lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, tetapi saya hendak bertanya satu atau dua soalan lagi.
messages.zh: 解释了，不过我还想再问一两个问题。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like to ask a couple more questions.

etymology.historical_story: Pelali illustrates how Malay builds technical vocabulary from an everyday root. Lali describes a loss of feeling and also familiarity so strong that something no longer troubles a person. With the nominal prefix pe-, pelali names something that produces numbness or reduced awareness. This transparent word formation explains its meaning without requiring an unverified borrowing story. [DBP: lali](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lali).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lali＝没感觉；再加 pe-，就把它想成“让人没感觉的东西”——pelali。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与医护人员沟通时可以自然使用 ubat pelali；不清楚具体药物或作用时，可礼貌询问“Boleh doktor terangkan kesannya?”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于医疗说明和日常转述。谈论他人的治疗时尊重隐私，避免把接受麻醉或镇静说成软弱或胆小。
